ns2:section.sectionText: (Professional Research in Action) Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. The class will meet from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (with an hour break for lunch) on Saturdays at the Puerto Rican Cultural Center in Chicago (2703 W. Division Street) on the following dates: 9/8, 9/22, 10/6, 10/27, 11/10, 11/17 (10 a.m. to 1 p.m. only), 12/1. Students also attend a mandatory class session during LEEP weekend, on Saturday, 10/13, on the UIUC campus. Core course for the Community Informatics Corps.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Library & Information Science major(s). Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
